from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
roots=[Path('products/distribution')/name for name in ('sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit','sqlite-original-regression-exercise','sqlite-educational-download-fallback')]
for root in roots:
 print(str(root))
 for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
  if not p.is_file() or 'raw' in p.relative_to(root).parts: continue
  name=p.name.lower()
  if not any(word in name for word in ('verdict','provenance','rights','manifest','license','verification','decision','readme')): continue
  data=p.read_bytes()
  print(json.dumps({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(data)}))
